info.description: Public Application & Client APIs for Layr Platform
info.title: Layr Client API Engine

post.description: Creates an ephemeral guest user account in auth.users with role 'authenticated', is_anonymous set to true, null email/phone, and optional initial profile properties. Publishes auth.user.signed_up event and issues an Ed25519 JWT access token, rotated refresh token in auth.sessions, and authentication cookies.
post.summary: Initialize or sign in an anonymous guest user account

delete.description: Disables TOTP multi-factor authentication on auth.users for the authenticated user, clears the encrypted MFA secret, and publishes auth.mfa.disabled event. Requires authenticated user session.
delete.summary: Disable multi-factor authentication on user account

post.description: Generates a cryptographic RFC 6238 TOTP secret, stores it temporarily encrypted in the session cache, and returns an otpauth:// URI and QR code payload compatible with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Generate TOTP secret and setup URI for authenticator enrollment

post.description: Verifies a 6-digit TOTP passcode against the user's enrolled MFA secret using a short-lived challenge ticket (5-minute TTL) issued during password sign-in. On verification, issues an Ed25519 JWT access token, rotated refresh token, and creates a session record in auth.sessions.
post.summary: Verify MFA challenge ticket with TOTP passcode

post.description: Validates the initial 6-digit TOTP code against the pending setup secret, sets mfa_enabled to true on auth.users, stores the AES-encrypted secret permanently, and publishes auth.mfa.enabled event. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Verify initial TOTP code to complete MFA enrollment

post.description: Exchanges an OAuth2 / OIDC authorization code (with PKCE code_verifier challenge verification) or refresh token for an Ed25519 JWT ID token, access token, and refresh token according to OpenID Connect Core 1.0 specifications.
post.summary: Exchange authorization code or refresh token for OpenID Connect tokens

get.description: Retrieves standard OpenID Connect profile claims (sub, email, email_verified, phone, phone_verified, name) for the authenticated caller bearing a valid Bearer access token.
get.summary: Retrieve OpenID Connect Core 1.0 user claims

post.description: Generates a single-use 6-digit numeric OTP with configurable TTL and rate limiting, hashes it with Argon2id, stores it in auth.otps, and dispatches it via configured email or SMS provider (Twilio, Vonage, SendGrid, Resend, or SMTP).
post.summary: Request a one-time password verification code via email or SMS

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP code against stored Argon2id hash in auth.otps. On successful verification, marks contact method verified, issues an Ed25519 JWT access token and rotated refresh token, and creates an active session in auth.sessions.
post.summary: Verify one-time password code and issue authenticated session

post.description: Initiates WebAuthn / FIDO2 assertion ceremony, generating a cryptographic challenge and credential request options for the client browser or authenticator hardware.
post.summary: Begin WebAuthn passkey authentication ceremony

post.description: Verifies the client's WebAuthn assertion signature against the registered public key and signature counter stored in auth.passkeys. Issues an Ed25519 JWT access token, refresh token, and session record in auth.sessions.
post.summary: Verify WebAuthn passkey assertion signature and issue session

post.description: Initiates WebAuthn / FIDO2 credential creation ceremony, generating an attestation challenge, relying party metadata, and user entity options for hardware or platform passkey enrollment.
post.summary: Begin WebAuthn passkey registration ceremony

post.description: Validates client attestation response and public key, stores credential record in auth.passkeys, creates user identity, and issues an authenticated session with Ed25519 JWT tokens.
post.summary: Verify WebAuthn passkey registration attestation and store credential

post.description: Verifies single-use password recovery verification code, enforces password complexity and breach checks, updates password hash using Argon2id key derivation in auth.users, and revokes existing sessions.
post.summary: Confirm password reset with verification code and new password

post.description: Initiates password recovery for registered user, generating an Argon2id-hashed single-use verification code with cooldown guards and dispatching it to registered email or SMS destination.
post.summary: Request a password reset verification code via email or SMS

post.description: Authenticates application user with email or normalized E.164 phone and password. Verifies Argon2id hash, checks account lockout status and breach flags. If MFA is enrolled, returns an ephemeral mfa_ticket challenge; otherwise issues Ed25519 JWT access token, refresh token in auth.sessions, and session cookies.
post.summary: Authenticate with email or phone and password

post.description: Revokes active refresh token, deletes corresponding session record from auth.sessions, clears session cookies, and emits auth.user.signed_out event.
post.summary: Revoke active session and refresh token

post.description: Registers a new application user account with email or normalized E.164 phone, password complexity validation, breach detection, and Argon2id key derivation. Supports seamless upgrade of anonymous guest accounts. Dispatches verification code if confirmation is required; otherwise issues Ed25519 JWT tokens.
post.summary: Register a new application user with password

post.description: Validates submitted refresh token against SHA-256 hash in auth.sessions, checks session expiry and user lock status, rotates refresh token, and issues a freshly signed Ed25519 JWT access token with updated claims resolved from public.auth_claims.
post.summary: Exchange refresh token for fresh JWT access token

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user from auth.users, cascading deletion across auth.sessions, auth.identities, auth.passkeys, and user properties. Clears authentication cookies and emits auth.user.deleted event. Requires authenticated user session.

get.description: Retrieves authenticated user profile from auth.users, including email, phone, verification timestamps, role, custom properties JSON, MFA enrollment status, and lockout flags. Requires authenticated user session.
get.summary: Get profile and verification details of authenticated user

patch.description: Asserts uniqueness of the new email address, generates an Argon2id-hashed single-use verification code, and dispatches it to the requested email. The address is updated once verified. Requires authenticated user session.
patch.summary: Request update of authenticated user email address

post.description: Verifies submitted single-use code against pending email verification record, sets email_verified_at timestamp in auth.users, and updates primary email if part of an address change flow. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Confirm email verification code

post.description: Generates and dispatches a single-use verification code to the authenticated user's registered unverified email address. Rate-limited by IP and user cooldowns. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Request an email verification code for current email

post.description: Exports full personal data graph associated with the authenticated user, including profile metadata, linked authentication identities, active sessions, and passkey registrations in portable JSON format. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Export comprehensive user account data graph (GDPR Article 20)

get.description: Retrieves all registered WebAuthn / FIDO2 passkey credentials for the authenticated user from auth.passkeys, including credential IDs, friendly names, creation timestamps, and last used dates. Requires authenticated user session.
get.summary: List registered passkeys for current user

delete.description: Deletes a registered WebAuthn passkey credential from auth.passkeys belonging to the authenticated user. Prohibits deleting credentials belonging to other users. Requires authenticated user session.

patch.description: Updates the account password in auth.users. Verifies current password if one is already set, enforces password complexity and breach checks, and rehashes with Argon2id. Prohibited on anonymous accounts. Requires authenticated user session.
patch.summary: Change or set password for current user

patch.description: Normalizes new phone number to E.164, verifies uniqueness in auth.users, generates single-use verification code, and dispatches via SMS. Requires authenticated user session.
patch.summary: Request update of authenticated user phone number

post.description: Verifies submitted single-use SMS code against pending verification record, updates phone_verified_at in auth.users, and marks phone as verified. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Confirm phone verification code

post.description: Generates and dispatches a single-use verification code via SMS to the authenticated user's registered phone number. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Request a phone verification code for current phone

patch.description: Performs shallow merge of custom JSON properties into the properties column of auth.users for the authenticated user, validating JSON size limits. Requires authenticated user session.
patch.summary: Update custom personal properties on user profile

get.description: Returns active sessions from auth.sessions for the authenticated user, detailing IP address, user agent, creation date, expiry timestamp, and a flag indicating the current device session. Requires authenticated user session.
get.summary: List active sessions for current user

post.description: Revokes all active sessions in auth.sessions belonging to the authenticated user except the current device session, invalidating other refresh tokens immediately. Requires authenticated user session.
post.summary: Sign out of all other devices and sessions

delete.description: Deletes a specific session record from auth.sessions belonging to the authenticated user, terminating access for that device. Requires authenticated user session.
delete.summary: Revoke a specific user session by ID

post.description: Atomically modifies an integer counter in the KV store by step value (positive or negative) with optional TTL preservation, returning the updated integer.
post.summary: Atomically increment or decrement an integer counter

post.description: Fetches values for an array of keys from the distributed ephemeral KV cache in a single atomic pipelined round-trip, maintaining tenant/session key isolation.
post.summary: Batch get multiple ephemeral KV entries

post.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs with optional individual TTLs in the distributed KV cache in a single atomic round-trip.
post.summary: Batch set multiple ephemeral KV entries

delete.description: Evicts a key-value entry from the distributed KV cache.

get.description: Retrieves a key-value entry with session/tenant isolation from the distributed KV store. Returns 404 if expired or not found.
get.summary: Get an ephemeral KV entry by key

patch.description: Updates the expiration TTL of an existing key in the KV cache without altering its stored payload.
patch.summary: Refresh TTL of an existing KV entry

post.description: Stores a value in the KV cache using a { value, ttl } JSON envelope with optional set_nx conditional insertion flag (maximum payload 2 MB).
post.summary: Set an ephemeral KV entry with JSON envelope

put.description: Stores raw request body directly in the KV store with optional ?ttl= query parameter and optional set_nx conditional insertion flag.
put.summary: Put raw ephemeral KV entry with query TTL

get.description: Invokes a PostgreSQL stored function or procedure with arguments passed via query parameters, setting transaction-local caller RLS session claims.
get.summary: Execute read-only database stored function or procedure

post.description: Invokes a PostgreSQL stored procedure or function with JSON request body arguments, setting caller RLS session claims and returning execution results.
post.summary: Execute database stored function or procedure with JSON payload

get.description: Queries PostgreSQL table rows with dynamic filter predicates (eq, gte, in, like), JSON path filtering, relational foreign-key embedding, cursor/offset pagination, and multi-column sorting. Injects caller JWT session claims into transaction-local variables for native Row-Level Security (RLS) enforcement. Supports optional KV result caching via ?cache_ttl.
get.summary: Query table rows with dynamic filtering, sorting, and pagination

post.description: Inserts a single row or batch of JSON objects into PostgreSQL, automatically applying defaults and returning inserted tuples. Validates against RLS INSERT ... WITH CHECK policies, invalidates table query caches, and emits real-time CDC updates.
post.summary: Insert single or bulk rows with RETURNING *

delete.description: Deletes a row by primary key from PostgreSQL subject to caller RLS DELETE ... USING policies, invalidating table query caches and broadcasting CDC events.
delete.summary: Delete a row by primary key

get.description: Retrieves a single row from PostgreSQL by UUID or primary key, enforcing caller Row-Level Security (RLS) SELECT policies and executing within caller session claims.
get.summary: Get a single row by primary key

patch.description: Applies partial column updates to a row identified by primary key, validating against RLS UPDATE ... USING ... WITH CHECK policies, invalidating cached queries, and broadcasting CDC changes.
patch.summary: Partially update a row by primary key

put.description: Replaces column values for a row identified by primary key, validating against RLS UPDATE policies, invalidating table query caches, and broadcasting CDC changes.
put.summary: Update entire row by primary key

delete.description: Deletes file object binary payload from the storage backend (database or S3) and removes its metadata row from file_storage.objects. Emits file_storage.object.deleted event.

get.description: Streams binary object payload from configured backend (PostgreSQL database bytea or S3) with HTTP Range header support, Content-Type, Content-Length, and ETag validation. Enforces public bucket policy or valid capability credentials.
get.summary: Download a file object with byte-range support

head.description: Returns HTTP metadata headers (Content-Length, Content-Type, ETag, Last-Modified) for a stored file without streaming body payload.

post.description: Uploads binary object payload into the target bucket, enforcing size guards and MIME validation. Stores in backend, writes metadata to file_storage.objects, and emits object created/updated event.
post.summary: Upload a file object via POST

put.description: Stores binary payload in the specified bucket, enforcing bucket file size limits and MIME allowlists. Creates or updates metadata record in file_storage.objects and emits file_storage.object.created or file_storage.object.updated event.
put.summary: Upload a file object via PUT

post.description: Generates a cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 capability URL granting temporary read (GET) or write (PUT) access to a specific bucket and key path with configurable expiration TTL.
post.summary: Mint a presigned capability URL for temporary file access

post.description: Dynamic introspection and execution engine over PostgreSQL tables, supporting complex nested selections, arguments, variables, query depth limits (max depth guard), complexity budgets, and native RLS session context injection.
post.summary: Execute GraphQL query or mutation

post.description: Probes and extracts dimensions, format, file size, colorspace, and EXIF metadata from an uploaded image binary payload.
post.summary: Inspect image metadata from binary upload

get.description: Extracts structural metadata (width, height, format, file size, colorspace, EXIF, orientation) from a remote or storage image path using cryptographic signature verification.

Dynamically fetches, crops, resizes, optimizes, and transforms source images according to imgproxy option specifications. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature if enabled, caches transformed result, and streams binary image with appropriate Content-Type header.
get.summary: Transform and optimize an image dynamically

get.description: Returns cluster metadata, list of enabled platform services, public server base URL, and the derived publishable key required for SDK client initialization. Unrestricted public endpoint.
get.summary: Get dynamic cluster manifest and enabled services
